schema.description: This is an object representing a role in the system.

denied_permissions.description: Permissions explicitly denied for this role. Denials win over grants, including wildcards (e.g. denying `appointments.own.cancel` removes cancel even when the role has `appointments.own.*`). Superuser roles cannot have denials.

permissions.description: Granted permissions for this role. Built-in roles return their baseline grants; custom roles return the stored allow-list. Explicit denials are listed separately in `denied_permissions` and always win over grants (including wildcards).

schema.title: Role
